summary: First Busey Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting, where stockholders approved an amendment to the 2020 Equity Incentive Plan authorizing an additional 2,100,000 shares for equity awards. The filing also covers routine director elections and other matters submitted to a vote. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine regulatory update on shareholder approvals and board actions.
